package.name: aav_diffusion_planner
package.description: diffusion_planner: a trial planner (planner:=diffusion). A small flow-matching model (ONNX, run by the learn Pixi environment's ONNX Runtime as a child program) draws 16 paths; a guard (G1-G8) checks them; the lattice's path when none passes or it is late. Off by default; refused on the car.
